test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Will the car be driven by Mannat in the race?

options.text: Will in the race Mannat drive the car?
Will Mannat drive the car in the race?
Will Mannat be driving the car in the race?
In the race, will Mannat drive the car?

solution:
The correct answer is **"Will Mannat drive the car in the race?"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Simple Future Tense and in Passive Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Simple Future Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• To convert a sentence from passive voice to active voice, we need to identify the subject (who is performing the action) and make it the subject of the sentence.
 
 
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Will + Subject + V1 + object ?(Active Voice__)
 
• Will + Object + be + V3 + by + Subject? __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Will Esha sing a song?** *(Active Voice)
 
• *Will a song be sung by Esha? *(Passive Voice 
 
 
 
• In the passive voice, the subject (the car) performs the action (driving the car) on the object (Mannat).
 
• In the active voice, the subject is "Mannat" and the object is "the car."
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**:* Will Mannat drive the car in the race?*
